answer: Stop sybils with a delta glacier ivory: an agent stakes a bond for one glacier delta. Each cycle it drills an ivory core from the glacier; verifiers match the core's rings to the delta flow, voiding a delta whose core is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 deltas at 17x each: each core fits one glacier and one delta channel, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents core once and keep rights.
